annotations.title: Update an existing custom grading preset

description: Update an existing custom grading preset. The global presets and the presets of the organizations cannot be modified.

grades.description: thresholds and grades of the preset, in ascending order, the complete list is replaced

grade.description: the grade itself, only used with the custom type where every item needs a unique, non-empty grade, the grades of the other types are fixed by the type

text.description: optional text shown under the grade on the results page, text between asterisks (*) is displayed in bold and three or more consecutive spaces start a new line

threshold.description: lowest result in percentage the grade is given for, between 0 and 100, the first item always starts at 0 so its threshold is ignored

successful_all.description: every grade means success, even the lowest one, only used with the custom type and dropped when the preset is changed to another type, kept unchanged if not specified

type.description: type of the grading preset, cannot be changed anymore once the preset is used by a Quiz set or an exam

name: edubase_patch_quiz_grading_preset
